purpose: Document primary local registry/custody evidence and bounded anonymous full-geometry discovery.
assessment: City-specific registration responsibility is confirmed, but no public anonymous full-polygon parcel layer was established. No feature query was made because inspected official registration pages provide service and application requirements rather than a public geometry API.
registryAssessment: Hunan Government Service Network listings for Chenzhou identify the Chenzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and Chenzhou Real Estate Registration Center as the responsible city-level authority for real-estate registrations. The entry requires cadastral-survey materials, parcel maps, and parcel-boundary coordinates as application documents; it does not expose public parcel geometry.
